facts.claim: N26's vision is to change the relationship people have with money for the better.
N26 is a fully licensed German bank with deposit protection up to €100,000.
N26 operates in 24 markets worldwide and has over 8 million customers.
N26 was founded in Berlin in 2013, pioneering digital banking in Europe.
N26 broke even mid-2024 and reported its first profitable quarter.
N26 has an international team of 1,600 employees from more than 90 nationalities.
N26 is committed to creating a welcoming environment where everyone feels valued and respected.
N26 offers banking, saving, and investing in one app trusted by millions.
